overview: The DRDO CEPTAM Scheme is a recruitment initiative by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) aimed at hiring personnel for technical and administrative posts such as Senior Technical Assistant-B (STA-B) and Technician-A. It is part of DRDO's efforts to strengthen its workforce in research, development, and support functions across its laboratories and establishments. The scheme is advertised periodically, with the latest notification being CEPTAM-11 for STA-B and Technician-A positions.
objectives: Recruit qualified candidates for technical and administrative roles in DRDO
Strengthen DRDO's workforce in research and development establishments
Provide employment opportunities in defence research and development
Ensure availability of skilled personnel for DRDO's laboratories and centres
eligibility: Candidates must meet the educational qualifications, age limits, and other criteria specified for each post (e.g., STA-B and Technician-A) as detailed in the official advertisement. Eligibility varies by post and includes educational qualifications, age, and sometimes experience or specific technical skills.
benefits: Selected candidates receive a regular government job in DRDO with pay scale as per 7th CPC, allowances, job security, and opportunities for career growth in defence research and development. Benefits include medical facilities, leave entitlements, and other central government employee perks.
financial_support: The scheme offers a fixed monthly salary as per the pay matrix for the respective post (e.g., STA-B and Technician-A) under the 7th Central Pay Commission, along with dearness allowance, house rent allowance, and other applicable allowances. Exact figures are specified in the official recruitment notification.
application_process: 1. Check the official DRDO website for the latest CEPTAM advertisement (e.g., CEPTAM-11). 2. Read the eligibility criteria, post details, and instructions carefully. 3. Apply online through the designated portal as specified in the advertisement. 4. Upload required documents such as educational certificates, age proof, and category certificate (if applicable). 5. Submit the application before the last date. 6. Appear for the written examination/skill test as per the schedule. 7. Wait for result declaration and further selection process.
required_documents: Age proof (birth certificate, SSC certificate, etc.)
Photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, passport, etc.)
Any other document as specified in the advertisement (e.g., experience certificate, NOC)
deadlines: As per the specific CEPTAM notification (e.g., CEPTAM-11 had a last date for application as mentioned in the advertisement; exact date not provided in evidence)
implementing_agency: Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), Ministry of Defence, Government of India
contact_details: Email: Not explicitly provided in evidence for CEPTAM scheme; general DRDO contact: director.desidoc@gov.in (from newsletter)
caveats: Eligibility criteria vary by post and must be checked in the specific advertisement
Application is only accepted through the prescribed online/offline mode
Incomplete or late applications are rejected
Selection process includes written test, skill test, and document verification
Merit-based selection; no reservations beyond government norms
